plan.description: Three paired area folds. Same validation and test runs in each pair; only target-area training acquisitions are removed for cross-region evaluation.
plan.hyperparameter_policy: Original fixed defaults; no hyperparameter search or reuse of the previous tuned winners.

plan.selection_policy: Per-fold threshold and checkpoint from validation; no test tuning
plan.aggregation_policy: Equal-weight mean of three target-area folds; descriptive, no significance claim

limitations: Only three nearby KLT areas, three dates and one receiver; no cross-city/device claim.
Paired tests and validation acquisitions are identical; removing target-area training also reduces training size.
Complete acquisition separation, not strict chronological or leave-date-out evaluation; some same-day runs are adjacent.
Earlier development inspected November 9 runs; this suite is an exploratory comparison, not an untouched final benchmark.
One seed, three correlated area folds; small differences are not evidence of a statistically stable winner.
KLT3-649 excluded because the source declares its labels unreliable; no synthetic epochs added.

dataset.features_origin: All nine runs re-extracted with the same pinned Fossett RTKLIB SPP extractor; label times strictly verified; trailing C/N0 std recomputed locally

source_annotation_count_discrepancy.policy: Preserve source labels; no manual correction

report_scope: Current fixed-parameter suite; full local reports contain training traces.
